turns.question: By what criterion in the text would one recognize or verify "the criterion by which a challenge finding counts as overlapping one of the three named known issues"? Cite the lines that establish the criterion.
turns.answer: The specification requires that a finding "overlap" one of the three named known issues (AC-023, SC-001), but it never states an operational criterion for how one would recognize or verify that overlap — e.g., whether it means the finding's target requirement identifier matches one of the cited requirement IDs (REQ-009/AC-010, REQ-017/REQ-019/REQ-028, REQ-002), whether it means textual/topical similarity to the described issue, or some other test. The text only names the three issues and asserts the outcome condition; it supplies no rule for judging overlap itself.
